extracted.name: Simple Strawberry Sauce
extracted.description: Freshly sliced strawberries with sugar make a chunky, sweet sauce that requires no cooking. Delicious served with cheesecake, angel food cake, or pancakes.
ingredient_lines: 2 quarts fresh strawberries, cleaned, hulled and sliced
instruction_lines: Place strawberries in a large bowl. Sprinkle sugar evenly over berries; stir to coat. Let stand at room temperature, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Cover and chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
